name: training
description: Level 9: training. Lower level numbers win.

rules.rationale: Duplicate shingles inflate loss improvement without teaching anything. Deduplicate before sharding.
A held-out slice, taken by hash of document id so it is stable across runs.
Chinchilla ratio. Below 20 tokens per parameter the model is undertrained, not small.
Context length for the first rung. Raising it multiplies attention cost quadratically.
Keep the last two. A checkpoint that will not load is worth nothing; the previous one is worth everything.
